items.period: Modern vector redraw of the Shuowen small-seal form; depicts an ancient script style, not a dated artifact
items.tradition: Small seal script (小篆), Shuowen style
items.caption: This modern redraw shows 小 in Shuowen small-seal style. The central dot has become a vertical stroke between two side marks; this later shape does not settle what the earlier marks represented.
items.alt: Three black strokes: a long central vertical stroke between two shorter, slightly curved side strokes.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the seal-script form and the described graphic change while keeping the disputed interpretation of the earlier marks open.
items.rights: Public-domain dedication for the modern vector representation; Commons page also records CC0 information.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw, not an ancient inscription image. The earlier marks are interpreted either as abstract signs of smallness or as fine sand grains, and their referent remains uncertain.
